The '''Gensang''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] race. A [[spice]] thief of this [[Species/Legends|species]] acquired a [[Sekotan Personal Starship]] at some point before [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]] from an unfortunate young [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who had been murdered by the guardsmen of the [[emperor-governor]] of [[Serpine]].<ref name="RP">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>
